title: Uka Eco ukax Marka thiyankiwa
intro: Diosan irpäwipat jithiqtkäna uka markanjja, mä sapa jaqew anqäxat mistunïna, jupajj suytʼäwi ukat mä yatiyäwi aptʼataw tʼijtäna. Uka armat almax wiñayatakiw jan jaytjasis iyawsäwin chimpupar tukuñapäna.
clues: Markajar yatiyirinakar khitatäpkäna uk uñjta, ukampis markajajj sapüru jaqenakjam jaqsutäpjjänwa.
Jupanakan yatiyäwiparuw creyiyäta ukat cheqa yatichäwijj nayan sarnaqatajaruw istʼasi sasaw amuyayäta.
Nayajj markajaruw jawsayäta, khitinakarutï jan kuna premio mayipkäna ukanakar istʼapjjañapataki.
Marka jaya cheqat tʼijtjjayäta, jankʼakiw razonanïpjjañapatak chʼamachasiyäta.
Markajasti naya contraw sartasini, nayasti jiwayataw uñjasta, ukampis wiñay sumankañ jikxatta.
Allah jupax nayaruw sitäna: ‘Paraíso ukar mantam’, ukat markajan jach’añchäwip uñjapxañap munta.

verse: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know (36:26)
